title: SourceRelationValue
description: Reference aggregate value template for the SourceRelation panel: typed edges between SourceUnit / SourceInterface entries. Pack-owned. Examples used by the Repository Sourcing Pack: SymbolRef, TypeHierarchyEdge, ImplementationEdge, ImportEdge, CallEdge, DataflowEdge, DeploymentEdge. Operational form: the Pack declares per-slot value schemas in `pack-manifest.panels[].slots`; this file documents the shared envelope.
